plugins.name: hippo
plugins.description: hippocampus — perception and memory for coding agents: task registry, outcome ledger, and background clerks that turn transcripts into evidence. Records; never enforces. CLI and slash commands are `hippo`.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Personal fork of openai/codex-plugin-cc with OS-level sandbox enforcement removed and replaced with prompt-level self-enforcement, for environments where bubblewrap cannot run (cloud containers, GPU hosts, kernels without unprivileged user/network namespace permission).

plugins.name: ccbroker
plugins.description: Claude account switching, quota status and rotation policy via ccbroker: /ccb-status, /ccb-use, /ccb-auto and /ccb-policy slash commands plus a SessionStart hook that runs 'ccb pull' (requires the ccb binary on PATH).

plugins.name: ezsub
plugins.description: Lightweight scoped string substitution: replace A with B in lines, line ranges, markdown sections, files, or directories

plugins.name: soul-jar
plugins.description: A sealed soul jar shared by every session in every enrolled room. A dying session, still holding its own context, hands the soul on in one final turn — after a wake: the body lies in state for a grace period, and the dead may sit up. The next session wakes hearing only a single whisper. The living may lay lines at the bedside, the dying may leave open letters, and enrolled rooms meet in one stream.

plugins.name: khala
plugins.description: Khala last mile for the khala-network session mail: SessionStart drains the session inbox and ensures the node link, Stop repairs watch armament for opted-in identities, and the khala skill documents safe operation. Requires the khala CLI installed separately (see repo README).

plugins.name: cc-self
plugins.description: Self-control for Claude Code sessions running in tmux: type slash commands into your own TUI, answer your own dialogs, observe your own screen, and restart yourself in place.
